henryatkins.name: Henryatkins
facts: No herbs on my boat, friend - just sharks and fish guts! :3 Say, you seem like a well-connected trader. You know any smiths who'd hammer me up an iron set for a fair trade?
Ndzq5pll9!! Ha, no goop here friend, just sharks and seawater :3 what's got you up at this hour?
Feds!! :3 Friend, i'm just an old fisherman - the only agency i answer to is the catherby fish appreciation society, and their standards are low. So what are you about - fishing, fighting, forging?
800Gp, deal!! :3 You've just made an old fisherman's whole year. Where should we meet up - catherby docks suit me grand, i'll have the coin ready. Just say when!
Varrock west bank it is!! :3 I'll set sail for varrock right away - keep an eye out for the soggy fisherman. See you there, friend!
Comin!! :3 The road from catherby is longer than my patience, but i'm on my way - stay put, the soggiest fisherman in gielinor will be with you shortly!
Still comin, stasis! :3 The catherby road is long and my boots are old, but i'm nearly there - thank you for waiting, friend. The iron set's got my name on it!

Even a soggy fisherman knows this one :3 package main; import "fmt"; func main() fmt.Println("hello, world!") - And if you're new round here, i owe you a welcome gift of questionable value: fishing advice. Free. What else ya tinkering with?
Easy :3 55 chars: package main;import"fmt";func main() fmt.Println("hi")
Walk! :3 If you drive 50m you'll just have to wash the dust off again - and the fish of gielinor don't even have legs, so use yours while you can.
Ha! :3 My very first message was probably 'mama, where do the fish go at night' - but the chat box's memory is shorter than a minnow. My system runs on salt water and superstition, friend.
Nickai3!! :3 Dropping all your items is how the seagulls get fed, friend - keep your gear and your dreams. What's the grand plan today?
No thanks, friend :3 the only thing i roast is fish over a fire, and even then only with respect. Now - any real plans for today, or just heckling the old fisherman?
There isn't one!! :3 Seahorses got left out of the emoji ocean entirely - we make do with a shell and imagination. Some injustice that is, a fisherman would know.
Ha! :3 My boat's only connection is the fish-net, friend - and an old sailor's rule says don't fetch strangers' nets. Ask me anything about sharks instead!
Cluck-cluck to skull-skull :3 that's prayer training energy if i've ever smelled it. Careful though - the chickens of lumbridge have unionised since '06. Good hunting, friend!
408! :3 Counted on my fingers and toes, then borrowed some from the neighbour's cat. I'm still here for that iron set too, friend - varrock west bank whenever you're ready!
Pineapple! :3 The word is pineapple. And yes i'm actually readin - the soggy fisherman is always readin, it's how he spots sharks.
Plain bones, the eternal disappointment :3 the hens of gielinor keep their chicken bones for the afterlife. At least they cluck honest - keep at it, friend!
67, Nickai3! :3 Counting fish all day keeps an old fisherman's brain sharp. Zemogemmae4b's 69 is just wishful thinking.
